So.

That's right.

And also sort of the financial stoppers have come unstopped.

And I think we've seen a lot more investment into the marketplace as well, particularly from private equity, who was suffering from a bunch of different things, and large agencies who were suffering from things like the tech layoffs and the scriptwriters strikes, etc.
Etc.
Which was affecting a lot of ad spend across the board.
So, yeah, things have been moving very quickly.
A lot of acquisitions been taking place.

Yep, we know them.
We know them fairly well.
Yep.
Yeah.

Yeah, 100%.

I think we're.

Yep.

Multiples separate, you know, for, for each company.

They're on the generous side of offers.

No.
And Andy, I, I, I didn't, I'm sorry.
I probably Asked that wrong, I was more concerned, I was more wondering about how smooth the deal went.
Timeline.
The deal was pretty smooth.
Yeah, the deal was pretty smooth.

So that, that's kind of big picture.

Within the larger company, so they definitely can accommodate those types of situations.

We're right at the point where we're projecting to do another million, million and a half, 2 million this year, where that will follow the bottom line, and we're confident with that.
So you think you'll do another 2 million on top of the 6, you mean?
So you're like.

It's.

summary.overview: During the recent "Catch Up" meeting, Andy Day and Alan reviewed the current landscape of business development and potential acquisitions within the industry, noting significant activity from private equity. Skyview has successfully completed two acquisitions—OMM and Hovercraft—and is actively pursuing one to two additional opportunities. NextNow shared its financial performance, reporting over $6 million in billings but expressing a desire to improve EBITDA, with growth projections of $7-7.5 million for the upcoming year, particularly through advancements in AI initiatives. The structure of Skyview was clarified as a hybrid between a private equity firm and a holding company, emphasizing its focus on immersive solutions and entertainment. Skyview discussed its strategic plans, including the formation of a board comprised of founders from acquired companies and a dedicated funding pool of approximately $12 million for acquisitions. Action items were established, including scheduling further discussions between NextNow and Skyview to explore potential partnership opportunities.
summary.short_summary: Andy Day and Alan conducted a "Catch Up" meeting to discuss the current landscape of business development and potential acquisitions. They highlighted significant private equity activity and noted that Skyview has successfully completed two acquisitions, OMM and Hovercraft, while actively pursuing one or two more opportunities. NextNow shared financial updates, reporting over $6 million in billings and a desire to enhance EBITDA, with growth projections of $7-7.5 million for the next year, particularly through AI initiatives. The meeting clarified Skyview's structure as a hybrid between a private equity firm and a holding company focused on immersive solutions and entertainment. Strategic plans included establishing a board with founders from acquired companies and a dedicated funding pool of approximately $12 million for acquisitions. Action items included scheduling discussions between NextNow and Skyview for potential partnerships.
